006package dev.metaschema.cli.processor.completion;
007
008import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
009
010/**
011 * Provides shell completion code for a specific type.
012 * <p>
013 * Instances are registered with {@link CompletionTypeRegistry} and looked up by
014 * the type class specified in {@link org.apache.commons.cli.Option#getType()}
015 * or {@link dev.metaschema.cli.processor.command.ExtraArgument#getType()}.
016 */
017public interface ICompletionType {
018  /**
019   * Generate Bash completion code for this type.
020   *
021   * @return bash completion snippet, or empty string for freeform input
022   */
023  @NonNull
024  String getBashCompletion();
025
026  /**
027   * Generate Zsh completion code for this type.
028   *
029   * @return zsh completion snippet, or empty string for freeform input
030   */
031  @NonNull
032  String getZshCompletion();
033}
